senses.gloss:
पिण्ड् €1 Ā., €10 U. (पिण्डते, पिण्डयति-ते; पिण्डित)
—1 To roll into a lump or ball, put together.
—2 To join, unite.
—3 To heap or accumulate.

पिण्ड a. (-ण्डी f.)
 [पिण्ड्-अच्]
—1 Solid (घन).
—2 Compact, dense, close.

पिण्ड + .{@-ण्डः, -ण्डम्@}
—1 A round mass, ball, globe; as in अयःपिण्डः, नेत्रपिण्डः &c.
—2 A lump, clod (of earth &c.).
—3 A round lump of food, morsel, mouthful; स न्यस्तशस्त्रो हरये स्वदेहमुपानयत्
 पिण्डमिवामिषस्य R. 2. 59.
—4 A ball or lump of rice offered to the Manes at obsequial ceremonies
 or Śrāddhas; नूनं मत्तः परं वंश्याः पिण्डविच्छेददर्शिनः । न
 प्रकामभुजः श्राद्धे स्वधासंग्रहतत्पराः R. 1. 66, 8. 26; Ms. 3. 216, 9. 132, 136, 140;
 Y. 1. 159.
—5 Food in general; सफलीकृतभर्तृपिण्डः M. 5 ‘who was true to his masterʼs salt’
.
—6 Livelihood, sustenance, subsistence; पिण्डार्थमायस्यतः Mu. 3. 14.
—7 Alms; पिण्डपातवेला Māl. 2.
—8 Flesh, meat.
—9 The foetus or embryo in an early
[]
 stage of gestation.
—10 The body, corporeal frame; एकान्तविध्वंसिषु मद्विधानां पिण्डेष्वनास्था
 खलु भौतिकेषु R. 2. 57.
—11 A heap, collection, multitude.
—12 The calf of the leg; Māl. 5. 16.
—13 A round button.
—14 Anything round, thick, gross or solid.
—15 An object in general.
—16 A particular part of a house.
—17 (In astr.) A sine expressed in numbers.
—18 The twenty-fourth part of the quadrant of a circle.
—19 The frontal sinus of an elephant or its projection.
—20 A portico or shed in front of the door.
—21 Incense, frank-incense.
—22 (In arith.) Sum, total, amount.
—23 (In geom.) Thickness.
—24 The flower of a China rose.

पिण्ड + .{@-ण्डम्@}
—1 Power, strength, might.
—2 Iron.
—3 Fresh butter.
—4 An army.
—5 Water; L. D. B.

पिण्ड + -अक्षर a. containing a conjunct consonant.

पिण्ड + -अन्वाहार्य a. to be eaten after the funeral rice-ball has
 been offered to the manes; पिण्डान्वाहार्यकं श्राद्धं कुर्यान्मासानुमासिकम् Ms. 3. 122.
पिण्ड + -अन्वाहार्यकम् a meal in honour of the manes.
पिण्ड + -अभ्रम् hail.
पिण्ड + -अयसम् steel.
पिण्ड + -अलक्तकः a red dye.
पिण्ड + -अशनः, -आशः, -आशकः, -आशिन् m. a beggar.
पिण्ड + -अशनः, -आशः, -आशकः, -आशिन् m. a beggar.
पिण्डसः A beggar, a mendicant living on alms.
पिण्ड + -अशनः, -आशः, -आशकः, -आशिन् m. a beggar.
पिण्ड + -अशनः, -आशः, -आशकः, -आशिन् m. a beggar.
पिण्ड + -उदकक्रिया an oblation of obsequial rice-balls and water to the deceased.
पिण्ड + -उद्धरणम् participating in funeral offerings.
पिण्ड + -गोसः gum myrrh.
पिण्ड + -तैलम्, -तैलकः incense.
पिण्ड + -तैलम्, -तैलकः incense.

पिण्ड + -द a.
—1 one who gives food, one who supplies with bread or with any other means
 of subsistence; श्वा पिण्डदस्य कुरुते गजपुङ्गवस्तु धीरं विलोकयति
 चाटुशतैश्च भुङ्क्ते Bh. 2. 31.
—2 one who is qualified to give the funeral rice-balls to deceased ancestors; Y. 2. 132.
पिण्ड + -दा a mother

पिण्ड + -द + .({@-दः@})
—1 the nearest male relation who offers the funeral rice-ball.
—2 a master, patron.

पिण्ड + -दानम्
—1 presentation of the obsequial rice-balls.
—2 the funeral oblation made to deceased ancestors on the day of new-moon.

पिण्ड + -निर्वपणम् presenting obsequial rice-balls to the manes; अनयैवावृता
 कार्यं पिण्डनिर्वपणं सुतैः Ms. 3. 248, 261.
पिण्ड + -निवृत्तिः cessation of relationship (by श्राद्ध oblation).
पिण्ड + -पदम् a particular अङ्कभेद in Astronomy; Śabda C.
पिण्ड + -पातः giving alms; Māl. 1.
पिण्ड + -पातिकः one who lives on alms.
पिण्ड + -पादः, -पाद्यः an elephant.
पिण्ड + -पादः, -पाद्यः an elephant.
पिण्ड + -पितृयज्ञः the oblation to deceased ancestors on the evening of new moon.

पिण्ड + -पुष्पः
—1 the Aśoka tree.
—2 the China rose.
—3 the pomegranate.

पिण्ड + -पुष्पः + .({@-पुष्पम्@})
—1 the blossom of the Aśoka tree.
—2 the flower of China-rose.
—3 a lotus.

पिण्ड + -भाज् a. receiving or entitled to a share in the funeral rice-ball.
━m. (pl.) the deceased ancestors or manes; अहो दुष्यन्तस्य संशयमारूढाः
 पिण्डभाजः Ś. 6.
पिण्ड + -भृतिः f. livelihood, means of subsistence.
पिण्ड + -मूलम्, -मूलकम् a carrot.
पिण्ड + -मूलम्, -मूलकम् a carrot.

पिण्ड + -यज्ञः the presentation of the obsequial rice-balls to the deceased
 ancestors; पिण्डयज्ञावृता देयं प्रेतायान्नं दिनत्रयम् Y. 3. 16.

पिण्ड + -लेपः fragments of the obsequial rice-balls which cling to the
 hand; (these are presented to the three ancestors immediately preceding
 the great-grand father).

पिण्ड + -लोपः
—1 interruption in offering the funeral rice-balls (as the failure of issue).
—2 neglect in offering the funeral rice-balls (to the deceased ancestors).
[]

पिण्ड + -विषमः one of the ways of embezzlement namely inconsistency
 in dealing with fixed items; Kau. A. 2. 8. 26.
पिण्ड + -शर्करा sugar prepared from Yavanāla.

पिण्ड + -संबन्धः relationship between a living person and one deceased
 such as is sufficiently near to qualify the former to offer the obsequial
 rice-ball to the latter.
पिण्ड + -स्वेदः a hot poultice.

पिण्डकः, -कम्
—1 A lump, ball, globe.
—2 A round swelling or protuberance.
—3 A lump of food.
—4 The calf of the leg.
—5 Incense.
—6 Carrot.
—7 (In astr.) A sine expressed in numbers.
पिण्डकः, -कम् + .{@-कः@} A goblin, demon.

पिण्डकः, -कम्
—1 A lump, ball, globe.
—2 A round swelling or protuberance.
—3 A lump of food.
—4 The calf of the leg.
—5 Incense.
—6 Carrot.
—7 (In astr.) A sine expressed in numbers.
पिण्डता Condition of a body.
पिण्डनम् Forming globes; Bhāg. 3. 26. 43.
पिण्डनम् + .{@-नः@} A mound or bank.

—1 A bridge, causeway.
—2 A mound, ridge.
पिण्डातः Incense.

—1 A religious mendicant or beggar.
—2 A cowherd.
—3 A buffalo-herdsman.
—4 The Vikaṅkata tree.
—5 An expression of censure.

पिण्डिः, -ण्डी f.
—1 A round mass, ball.
—2 The nave of a wheel.
—3 The calf of the leg.
—4 The Aśoka tree.
—5 The long gourd (अलाबु).
—6 A house.
—7 A species of palm.
—8 A stool or seat.
—9 A pedestal for the image of a deity.

पिण्डिः + -पुष्पः the Aśoka tree.
पिण्डिः + -लेपः a kind of unguent.

पिण्डिः + -शूरः ‘brave in the house’, or ‘a cake-hero’, a braggart, cowardly
 boaster, poltroon, coqtuean; राक्षसान् वटुयज्ञेषु पिण्डीशूरान् निरस्तवान्
 Bk. 5. 85; cf. गेहेनर्दिन्, गेहेशूर &c.

—1 A round or fleshy swelling.
—2 The calf of the leg &c.; विकटोद्बद्धपिण्डिकम् Mb. 1. 155. 33.
—3 The region of the cheeks (गण्डस्थल); भिन्नमस्तकपिण्डिकाः Mb. 7. 116. 25;
 see पिण्डि above.

पिण्डित a. [पिण्ड्-क्त]
—1 Pressed or rolled into a ball or lump.
—2 Thick, lumpish.
—3 Heaped together, collected; एष पिण्डितार्थः M. 1 ‘this is the meaning on the whole’.
—4 Mixed with; न समा मम वीर्यस्य शतांशेनापि पिण्डिताः Mb. 10. 12. 17.
—5 Added, multiplied.
—6 Counted, numbered.
पिण्डित + .{@-तः@} Incense.

पिण्डिन् a.
—1 Receiving the funeral rice-balls (as ancestors).
—2 Having a body. ━m.
—1 A beggar.
—2 One who offers funeral rice-balls to the manes.

पिण्डिल a.
—1 Having large calves.
—2 Skilled in calculations.

पिण्डीकृ €8 U.
—1 To make into a lump, press together, unite.
—2 To concentrate.
—3 To identify with.
पिण्डीभू €1 P. To be made into a ball or lump, become solid.
पिण्डीर a. Sapless, insipid, arid, dry.

पिण्डीर + .{@-रः@}
—1 The pomegranate tree.
—2 Cuttle-fish-bone.
—3 Foam of the sea; cf. डिण्डीर.
पिण्डोलिः f. Fragments dropped from the mouth, offal, leavings of a meal.

पिण्याकः, -कम्
—1 Oil-cake; कणान् वा भक्षयेदब्दं पिण्याकं वा सकृन्निशि Ms. 11. 92;
 Bhāg. 5. 9. 11.
—2 Incense.
—3 Saffron.
—4 Asafoetida.
—5 Residue of seeds ground for oil; श्रेयस्तैलं च पिण्याकात् Pt. 3. 99.

पिण्याकः, -कम्
—1 Oil-cake; कणान् वा भक्षयेदब्दं पिण्याकं वा सकृन्निशि Ms. 11. 92;
 Bhāg. 5. 9. 11.
—2 Incense.
—3 Saffron.
—4 Asafoetida.
—5 Residue of seeds ground for oil; श्रेयस्तैलं च पिण्याकात् Pt. 3. 99.
